profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Import/export/validation pipelines for "big data" and ETL systems (AWS Kinesis/Glue/Athena, Apache Spark/Iceberg)
- Backend: data processing, SQL endpoints, metadata management (AWS Lambda/ECS/Fargate/DynamoDB/S3, Kotlin/Java/Scala/TypeScript/Python)
- Performance engineering: updating open-source and internal packages (databases, machine learning, flamegraphs/profiling, AWS Graviton)
- Benchmark system design/automation and results analysis (Jupyter/Pandas/Matplotlib, Ansible/Python/Bash, AWS EC2)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack, Conversion Team
- Lead design of the engine powering life insurance questionnaires
- Fixed key issues with storing sensitive information, third-party APIs, UI/UX
- Built a generator to create mock life insurance applications for all 50 states

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend, Financial Products ("Uber Cards" team)
- Designed and built the platform powering the American Express Platinum experience at Uber
- Refreshed the Visa Local Offers program to support 1000s of requests/sec, new features, new API
- Enhanced the Uber Visa points redemption process to maintain accurate points balances automatically
- Maintained the infrastructure powering Uber Cash, Uber's customer currency / gift card platform
- Added financial products data and features to Bliss, Uber's global customer service web application
- Responsible for QA, DevOps, and SRE duties for team-owned backend services
- Served as Internship Coordinator, drove FinProd Tech Talks and the team sprint process

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed pipelines for detecting and measuring objects in video (OpenCV)
- Used Python data science libraries to visualize and analyze sensor data
- Started development of desktop app in Qt (C++ cross-platform framework)
- Designed/assembled system to record/process 50TB of uncompressed video

positions.title: Senior Tutor, Coding Bootcamp
positions.description:
- Online and in-person web development tutor for Trilogy-hosted bootcamps in Austin and nationwide
- Helped dozens of students understand key coding concepts and apply knowledge to assignments
- Taught HTML, CSS, and Javascript fundamentals, Node.js/Express, MySQL, and other topics on demand
- Created custom lessons, code demonstrations, and exercises as needed

positions.title: Business Owner, A/V System Design and Control System Programming
positions.description:
- Designed, programmed, and installed large ($20k+) audio/video and network systems for commercial and residential clients
- Coordinated lighting, A/V, temperature, access control, security/surveillance, network, and power systems with control system macros, timers, and conditional automation
- Created rich UIs for touchpanels / remote controls / smartphones / tablets
- Configured commercial network routers (Mikrotik), switches (Cisco/Luxul) and access points (Ubiquiti) 
- Controlled and monitored local network devices, including devices without a published API (via Wireshark)
- Monitored and supportted remote system with VPNs and web-enabled power controllers
- Certifications: Lutron, RTI, URC, OSHA, Lift Operator

projects.title: Alexa VR
projects.description:
Create your pet and battle against other pets, Pokemon-style - all in VR using Alexa voice commands!

- Powered by: AFrame VR (aframe.io), Amazon Alexa (AWS Lambda), React/Flux/React Router, MySQL/Sequelize

projects.title: "Cheevr"​ with Amazon Echo
projects.description:
Allows users to create true-false and multiple choice quizzes they can take with their voice, via our Alexa skill on an Amazon Echo or other Alexa device.

- Perfect for any kind of studying or learning, similar to having a friend quiz you
- Login with Amazon for the website and Alexa skill permits anyone to take quizzes at any time and record their results
- Only available website/skill allowing users to create their own content for Alexa
- Algorithms choose questions based on past performance, reinforcing questions you tend to answer incorrectly
